title: Issue trackers
intro: Turn a follow-up action into a ticket in Jira, Linear, GitLab or GitHub. When the ticket is closed, the action is marked done in Ronde.
name: Name
tokenKept: A token is saved. Type a new one to replace it.
removeConfirm: Remove {name}? Existing tickets stay, they are no longer followed.

hints.jira: An API token created at id.atlassian.com, for the account whose email is above.
hints.linear: A personal API key from Linear settings → API. The team key (ENG in ENG-12) comes before each issue number.
hints.gitlab: A project or personal access token with the api scope. Project: its path (group/project) or its number.
hints.github: A fine-grained token with “Issues: read and write” on the repository.

assignee: Owners are assigned in GitLab and GitHub when their username is in their directory profile.
